verdict.rationale: Outlook documents automations in the form of Inbox rules that apps can set up, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the pack shows version history, review, or rollback for those rules. Rule creation via the Graph API is at most a developer building block for building versioning externally, and the community 'roll back' comment concerns uninstalling the new Outlook client, not automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
